Notchwise uses Automation to move files, send items to the Trash, open requested commands and control playback in your media apps. The Notchwise assistant uses it to send the messages, emails and notes you ask for, after you confirm them.
Notchwise uses each app's audio to adjust its volume in the mixer, to move Dynamic Island's music bars and to include the Mac's sound in the screen recordings you start. Nothing leaves your Mac.
Notchwise uses Bluetooth only to read the battery level of connected peripherals. Nothing leaves your Mac.

Notchwise listens while you hold the dictation or assistant key. Notchwise records your microphone only when you turn it on for a screen recording. The audio stays on your Mac unless you choose to create a temporary link.
Notchwise turns your speech into text on this Mac.
Show your upcoming appointments in the notch, and add the events you ask the Notchwise assistant for. Calendar events stay on this Mac.
The Notchwise assistant creates the reminders you ask for.
The Notchwise assistant looks up who you mean when you say "text Mom" or "email Priya".
Notchwise shows your camera only in the preview window you open, so you can check how you look before a call. Nothing is recorded or leaves your Mac.
Notchwise checks local metadata in Downloads to review, organize or trash only confirmed WhatsApp files you choose. The Cleaner also looks for forgotten screenshots when you save screenshots here.
Notchwise organizes confirmed WhatsApp downloads in a destination folder you explicitly choose. The Cleaner also looks for forgotten screenshots when you save screenshots here.
